metadata.article_title: Probate of contents or lost of destroyed will.

article.title: Probate of contents or lost of destroyed will.
article.content: When a will has been lost or destroyed and no copy has been made nor the draft preserved, probate may be granted of its contents if they can be established by evidence.
article.html:
238Probate of contents or lost of destroyed will.

Section 238 · Part IX · Chapter II · page 72 of the Act

When a will has been lost or destroyed and no copy has been made nor the draft preserved, probate may be granted of its contents if they can be established by evidence.
